visualCharacteristics.layout: image-with-content: ~620px image beside heading + accented body; 'left' puts the image left, 'right' puts it right; stacked on mobile with the image first
visualCharacteristics.background: Grey band on alternate rows comes from section style 'grey'

contentPattern.structure: one row; cells in visual order. image-with-content left = [picture | H2 + paragraphs], right = [H2 + paragraphs | picture]; without an image a single [H2 + paragraphs] cell

reuseGuidance: Author as 'Columns (image-with-content, left)' or 'Columns (image-with-content, right)'; put cells in visual order. Pair with section-metadata Style 'image-with-content' (add ', grey' for the grey band).
